reason: Pack aluminization supplies the Al absent from HfNbTaTiZr and could plausibly establish a slow-growing Al2O3 barrier, whereas B extrapolates a fluorine effect that depends on Al2O3 formation in Al-rich TiAl to an Al-free alloy and offers no evidence that its Hf/Nb/Ta mixed oxides would be protective. A still needs quantitative acceptance thresholds and must test brittle interdiffusion-layer formation, but its intervention and controlled oxidation/mechanical comparison are materially sounder.
